caption: Duran v. Fairton Federal Correctional Institution
citation_line: Duran v. Fairton Federal Correctional Institution, No. 1:23-cv-12960 (D.N.J. June 2, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge O'Hearn dismissed First, Fifth, and Eighth Amendment damages claims arising from allegedly retaliatory and mistaken placements in a federal prison's special housing unit, holding that the requested extensions of Bivens were foreclosed after Egbert and related precedent.
qualification_rationale: The opinion supplies a concrete, recent application of the Supreme Court's sharply narrowed Bivens doctrine to prison retaliation, procedural-due-process, and conditions claims. It clears the significance gate on doctrine but remains supplemental because it applies settled limits and has no identified appellate or press significance.
appellate_posture_note: No appellate disposition was identified as of the cutoff.
